name: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest private hospital chain with integrated pharmacy distribution/retail (Apollo HealthCo, Apollo Pharmacy, Apollo 24/7), diagnostics and primary-care clinics. TTM revenue Rs 27,630 cr (+19%), EBITDA Rs 4,244 cr (15%), PAT Rs 2,338 cr. Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 7,615 cr (+23%), EBITDA Rs 1,191 cr, PAT Rs 660 cr; Reuters notes expansion costs weighed on the share price (2026-11-05). NCLT approved a composite scheme of arrangement among four group entities on 2026-11-04.

exposures.mechanism: Premium urban volumes, occupancy and ARPOB drive hospitals (~47% of sales, ~75% of EBITDA; model estimate). +5pp urban consumption -> +2pp inpatient revenue growth -> hospital EBITDA +4% at ~35% incremental margin -> group EBITDA +3%, persistence 0.8, EV/MCap 1.05 -> +2.5.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 7,615 cr (+23%), PAT Rs 660 cr (+34%, screener); Reuters 2026-11-05: shares slip as expansion costs cloud strong results

exposures.mechanism: Healthcare spend elasticity ~1.2 to GDP; +1pp GDP -> +1.2pp revenue growth, operating leverage 2x -> +2.

evidence.note: screener.in financials retrieved 2026-11-05; weight is model-derived (see mechanism)

exposures.mechanism: Mix shift to complex/oncology/robotics procedures and international patients lifts ARPOB (Moneycontrol 2026-11-04: occupancy and premium procedures drove margins). +1 SSU = faster mix upgrade -> +2.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 7,615 cr (+23%), PAT Rs 660 cr (+34%, screener); Reuters 2026-11-05: shares slip as expansion costs cloud strong results

exposures.mechanism: Insurance-regulatory tightening on cashless/TPA rate-setting and claims pressures hospital tariffs; payer mix ~50% insured: 3% tariff cut on insured volume -> -1.5% hospital revenue -> about -9% hospital EBITDA (-7% group); weighted probability 0.3, persistence 1.0, EV/MCap 1.05 -> -2.5.
